name: Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1-upscaled
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1 (config.json max_position_embeddings 32768, rope_theta 1e6). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own. NOTE the merge did change the shape: the card's mergekit passthrough slices are [0,8),[4,12),[8,16),[12,20),[16,24),[20,28),[24,32), seven slices of eight layers with a 4-layer overlap on each seam, so the released config.json declares num_hidden_layers 56 against the base's 32 and the checkpoint is 81.5 GB, not 46.7 B parameters of work.
attention_variant: Inherited block shape from mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1 - 32 query heads, 8 KV heads (GQA ratio 4), head_dim 128, SwiGLU MoE with 8 experts and 2 active - but stacked 56 layers deep instead of 32 by a mergekit passthrough frankenmerge. KV cache therefore costs 56/32 = 1.75x the base per token (229,376 B/token at bf16 vs 131,072), which is the real price of the +0.30 mt-bench 1-turn average.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. A mergekit passthrough frankenmerge of mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1 with itself: seven 8-layer slices with 4-layer overlaps, giving 56 layers against the base's 32. NOT the same model at the same cost - 81.5B total parameters and ~22.2B active per token against the base's 46.7B/12.9B, so it buys +0.30 on mt-bench 1-turn average (8.00625 -> 8.30625, with Coding 5.3->6.3 and Reasoning 6.0->7.7) at roughly 1.75x the KV cache and 1.7x the active FLOPs per token. It also REGRESSES on 2-turn mt-bench, 7.5375 -> 7.1125, and on 1-turn Math (6.8 -> 5.4) and Extraction (8.5 -> 8.4). Both rows are recorded because the card prints both tables. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2024-03-25. The only benchmark is mt-bench, an LLM-judged score out of 10.
